headline: NQ is +1.0% after Friday's −3.5% NDX rout, pressing its overnight high as oil drops ~6% on US–Iran diplomacy and yields and the dollar ease. Small long while NQ holds above the overnight midpoint; ISM at 10:00, Apple/Palantir after the close and Tuesday's midterms cap conviction.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window · ISM Manufacturing 10:00 AM ET · Goolsbee 11:15 · AAPL/PLTR after close · midterms Tue

flip.long: Stays LONG while NQ holds above the overnight midpoint ~28,715. Adds conviction on a break of the overnight high 28,844 and Friday's NDX high 28,713 (≈ NQ 28,862), especially if the 10-year stays under 4.90%.
flip.short: NQ loses ~28,715 → STAND ASIDE; breaks the overnight low 28,587 (≈ NDX 28,438) → SHORT, meaning the rebound failed and Friday's selling is resuming. Stronger below Friday's settle 28,534.

thesis: There's a small long edge at the open, low conviction. The NDX fell **3.46% Friday to 28,384.85** (range 28,093.24–28,713.45), its worst day since June, after Amazon's miss and Intel's −28% guide [1,6]. Over the weekend the tape turned: **oil is down ~6% (WTI ~$97.5, Brent ~$106.4)** as Iran and Qatar held a third day of talks on ending the war and OPEC+ held December output steady [3,7]. **NQ is +278 pts / +0.97% at 28,812.00 (8:43 AM ET)**, near the top of a 28,587.00–28,844.00 overnight range, having climbed steadily from a Sunday-evening ~28,630 start [2,4,5]. On Friday's ~149-pt futures premium, that implies a cash open near ~28,660, close to Friday's 28,713 NDX high [1,2]. Macro is supportive: the 10-year is −2.5 bp at ~4.90%, the dollar −0.3% at ~101.56, and VIX is a touch lower at ~19.1 [9]. The rebound is broad but modest: ES +0.6%, Dow futures +0.7%, and in premarket NVDA, MSFT and GOOGL are ~+0.7%, PLTR +1.9%, AMD +1.1%, with Apple flat ahead of its report [2,9]. December hike odds are ~72% (CME FedWatch) [8]. So the call is **a small LONG while NQ holds above its overnight midpoint ~28,715**, but ISM Manufacturing (est. 54.7; prices paid was 77.9) lands 30 minutes after the open, and Apple, Palantir and Tuesday's midterms sit right behind it, so keep size small.

bullets.label: The gap is up, and it's holding near the highs.
bullets.text: NQ is +0.97% at 28,812.00, near the top of its 28,587.00–28,844.00 overnight range after a steady climb from Sunday's ~28,630 start [2,4]. On a ~149-pt premium, that implies a cash open around ~28,660, just under Friday's 28,713 NDX high [1,2]. That's an estimate, not a quote.

bullets.label: Oil's drop is the macro catalyst.
bullets.text: WTI is −6.3% at ~$97.5 and Brent −6.2% at ~$106.4 on Iran–Qatar talks to end the war and no military escalation over the weekend; OPEC+ kept December output unchanged [3,7]. That eases inflation and hike fears: the 10-year is ~4.90% (−2.5 bp) and the dollar is −0.3% [9].

bullets.label: Tech is bouncing after a capitulation-style Friday.
bullets.text: The NDX fell 3.46% Friday, its worst day since June, and lost ~6.5% in October [1,6]. This morning semis are bouncing (SOXX +1.6% early) and NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL are ~+0.7% premarket, PLTR +1.9% before its report [2,6].

bullets.label: The first 30 minutes are the clean window.
bullets.text: ISM Manufacturing lands at 10:00 AM ET (est. 54.7, prior 54.5; prices paid prior 77.9) and Goolsbee speaks at 11:15 [10]. There's no 8:30 data today.

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: A +1% bounce after a −3.5% day is a small retrace, and the AI-capex worries behind Friday's selloff (Amazon, Intel) haven't gone away [5,6]. A hot ISM prices index could push yields back toward 5% with December hike odds already ~72% [8,10]. Traders may also cut risk before Apple and Palantir after the close and Tuesday's midterms, and Reuters notes oil could swing back toward $120 if Iran rhetoric heats up after the vote [3,5].

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: Oil's ~6% drop, lower yields and a softer dollar are the cleanest macro mix in weeks [3,9]. Futures have climbed all night with no real pullback, and an oversold NDX after its worst month since March 2025 can squeeze through Friday's high [2,6].

bullets.label: Stay/scale LONG:
bullets.text: NQ holds above the overnight midpoint ~28,715 through the first 30 minutes. Add on a break of the overnight high 28,844 with cash NDX above Friday's 28,713 high, ideally with oil staying under $100 and the 10-year under 4.90%.

bullets.label: Flip to SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ breaks the overnight low 28,587.00 (≈ NDX 28,438), meaning the rebound failed. Stronger below Friday's settle 28,534, which fills the gap.

bullets.label: Flip to STAND ASIDE:
bullets.text: NQ loses ~28,715 but holds above 28,587, or ISM at 10:00 sends yields sharply higher. Cut size into the close either way: Apple and Palantir report after the bell and the midterms are Tuesday.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: ISM prices paid at 10:00 AM ET, Goolsbee at 11:15, US–Iran headlines and oil, and pre-election positioning [3,7,10].
